reviewNotes: Reviewed all 20 cards and 131 distinct speech keys against data/pages84-about-pork.json vocabulary/furigana. Verified breed/production terms くろぶた, さんげんとん, よんげんとん, めいがらぶた and ほうぼくぶた. Restored missing 霜降り readings to しもふり; corrected 四つ to よっつ and contextual 何を to なにお. Resolved duplicated SPF prefix and supplied hiragana acronym えすぴーえふ and English expansion approximation すぺしふぃっく ぱそじぇん ふりー. Retained source distinction 肉汁 にくじる / にくじゅう under separate keys. Converted loanwords to hiragana retaining long vowels. Reviewed contextual topic は, directional へ and object を, preserving lexical はし/はごたえ/はいって/はいる/はんだん/はんばい/はんしょく and lexical こうはい. Questions, dialogue prompts, sentence explanations and extended answers use Nova generation speed 1.0; vocabulary and very short phrase/groups use 0.85. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or audible pitch-accent verification performed.
